description: Kartenlayer Schifffahrtskanal NRW (GSK3C, Auflage 30.11.2010) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by LANUK NRW. The map layer "shipping canal" represents the axes of the shipping canals in North Rhine-Westphalia. The shipping canals are part of the water stationing map of the state of North Rhine-Westphalia. Coverage: LANUK NRW. The portal shows the English title as "Map layer shipping channel NRW (GSK3C, edition 30.11.2010)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is LANUK NRW. Its keywords include Gewässerflächen, LANUK-Kartenlayer, gsk3c, Teileinzugsgebiete, LANUK, NRW. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, GML. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
